# Monthly, players only: the service reports on its own once when the situation turns dangerous.
COLDWAR_EB_advisor_auto = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = no
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_adv_auto_cd }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EB_frozen }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_unrest > 59.999 }
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_EB_pressure > 59.999 }
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EB_adv_auto_cd days = 365 value = 1 }
		COLDWAR_EB_advisor_analyse = yes
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EB_adv.2 }
	}
}
